name: record-variable-definition-test-0c506ca119/record-variable-definition-e.bal
reason: The negative test includes record destructuring assignments such as {name: s, ...rest} = p and {x: xx, y: yy, ...extra} = <ClosedXY>{...}, asserting rest-field and field-type assignability diagnostics. These require mapping binding patterns in destructuring assignments, while the subset explicitly supports only wildcard binding patterns there. This essential unsupported construct makes the whole case a feature request even though record variable declarations and many other type-error checks are in scope.
unsupported_constructs: Mapping binding patterns (including named fields and rest bindings) in destructuring assignment statements
test_design_notes: Negative diagnostic test with @error markers; unsupported assignment patterns are directly involved in asserted assignability errors.
